name: Temple Healer
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: There is a priest waiting here to heal the wounded. She smiles kindly
desc4: at you as you enter. A small bowl of silver nobles stands on the table
desc5: she sits behind, and you can see it is nearly full. A stone stairwell
desc6: descends into the catacombs of the temple at the rear of this room,
desc7: and you can exit into the main hall to the south.
